basic_details.job_title: South Zone Cultural Centre Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 25 Steno, Assistant Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Deputy Director, Assistant Director, Stenographer, Programme Executive, Assistant, Assistant Engineer, Documentation Officer, Junior Hindi Translator and other posts
basic_details.short_information: South Zone Cultural Centre (SZCC), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, has invited applications for 25 Group A, Group B and Group C posts. The vacancies include Deputy Director, Assistant Director, Programme Executive, Assistant Engineer, Documentation Officer, Junior Hindi Translator, Junior Assistant, Stenographer and other posts. Recruitment will be conducted through deputation, short-term contract or direct recruitment, depending on the position.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 45 days from publication in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar

application_fee.details: The non-refundable fee must be paid through a Demand Draft drawn in favour of Director, South Zone Cultural Centre, Thanjavur, payable at Thanjavur. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications and separate fees.

age_limit.age_details: 18 to 65 years, depending on the post and recruitment mode

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.szccindia.org.
Download the applicable application form for direct recruitment, deputation or short-term contract.
Fill in the application using capital or block letters.
Attach self-attested copies of educational, age, experience and category certificates.
Prepare a Demand Draft of Rs.100 if the application fee applies.
Submit a separate application and fee for every post applied for.
Write “Application for the Post of …………………” on the envelope.
Send the completed application to the Director, South Zone Cultural Centre, Thanjavur.
Ensure that the application reaches the office within 45 days from publication in Employment News or Rozgar Samachar.
important_instructions: Only Indian citizens by birth or domicile are eligible. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. The post name must be clearly written on the envelope. The application should be filled in capital letters for clarity. A separate application must be submitted for every post. The advertised posts carry all-India transfer and service liability. The normal deputation period will not exceed three years. The short-term contract period will be three years. A character certificate and medical fitness certificate may be required at the time of appointment or joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SZCC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.szccindia.org . Download the applicable application form for direct recruitment, deputation or short-term contract. Fill in the application using capital or block letters. Attach a recent passport-size photograph. Attach self-attested copies of educational, age, experience and category certificates. Prepare a Demand Draft of Rs.100 if the application fee applies. Submit a separate application and fee for every post applied for. Write “Application for the Post of …………………” on the envelope. Send the completed application to the Director, South Zone Cultural Centre, Thanjavur. Ensure that the application reaches the office within 45 days from publication in Employment News or Rozgar Samachar.
